claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with usage-based forecasting and customer value realization.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls to improve runtime resilience.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, validation, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling more repeatable deployment decisions.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms by integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with vector services and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a focused operating model.
